## 1. AEG-GEM-01 · Aegis: California homeowners insurance as the Department of Insurance explains it (coverages A to F, replacement cost, extended replacement, the FAIR Plan, the home inventory, claim deadlines)

**Due:** 2026-12-06 · **State:** now

**Why:** Aegis checks the house's contents against the personal-property limit. Joseph should also see, from the regulator, what each coverage letter means, what replacement cost versus actual cash value changes, and how long an insurer has to answer a claim.

**What it unlocks:** Aegis's cover panel explains each limit it reads and the claim timeline in the Claims section.

**Read first:**
- https://www.insurance.ca.gov (the residential insurance consumer pages and guides)
- California Code of Regulations, title 10, sections 2695.5 and 2695.7 (Fair Claims Settlement Practices)
- https://www.cfpnet.com (the FAIR Plan's own pages)

**Do this:**
1. One row per point: each coverage A to F (what it pays for); replacement cost and actual cash value; extended replacement cost; what the FAIR Plan is and what it does not cover; what CDI says to put in a home inventory; the claim deadlines (acknowledge, accept or deny, pay) with the regulation section.

**Make:** `aegis_gemini_ca-homeowners_{YYYYMMDD-HHMM}.json`

**Save in:** Prometheus Hub/Pillars/Prometheus Hub/incoming (AI drop files)/

**Every field, exactly:**

- `quote` (text): the words on the page that say it, copied exactly

## 3. AEG-GEM-03 · Aegis: what California and federal law say about warranties and service contracts (Song-Beverly, Magnuson-Moss), with the section for each

**Due:** 2026-12-10 · **State:** now

**Why:** Aegis lists the warranties Hearth and Records hold. Joseph should know what the law adds on top: implied warranties and how long they last, what a written warranty must state, and the rules for extended warranties (service contracts).

**What it unlocks:** Aegis's warranty list explains what is still covered after a written warranty ends, and when a service contract can be cancelled.

**Read first:**
- California Civil Code sections 1790 to 1795.8 (Song-Beverly Consumer Warranty Act) on https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov
- 15 U.S.C. 2301 to 2312 and the FTC's guide https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/businesspersons-guide-federal-warranty-law

**Do this:**
1. Rows: the implied warranty of merchantability and of fitness (what each is, how long it lasts in California, 1791.1); full versus limited written warranties (Magnuson-Moss); what a written warranty must disclose; service contracts in California (who must be licensed, cancellation and refund rules, 1794.4 and 1794.41); repair time and the number of attempts before a replacement or refund (1793.2).

**Make:** `aegis_gemini_warranty-law_{YYYYMMDD-HHMM}.json`

**Save in:** Prometheus Hub/Pillars/Prometheus Hub/incoming (AI drop files)/

**Shape:** `JSON array, one object per row, exactly the fields below`

**Every field, exactly:**
- `n` (number): 1, 2, 3 ...

- `point` (text): one plain sentence
- `section` (text): the section number
- `quote` (text): the words of the section, copied exactly
- `source_url` (url): the official page that shows the value (a .gov, the statute, or the agency's own page)
- `checked` (date): the day you read it, YYYY-MM-DD
